gap_definition: log(Open_t / Close_previous_eligible); previous eligible uses the SAME positive-volume, valid-candle sequence as the existing feature builder
body_definition: log(Close_t / Open_t); available only after origin close, used to predict next observation
identity: Gap_Log + Body_Log = Log_Return; do not keep Log_Return as an input in B
reuse_A: verified existing artifacts; exact dates, features, targets, versions and parameters required
training_and_thresholds: exact folds, hyperparameters, nonzero policy, calibration/validation and margin grid from control study

feature_selection.Ridge_shared: minimum validation return RMSE; exact ties prefer A
feature_selection.Logistic_raw: maximum validation balanced nonzero forced direction; exact ties prefer A

Ridge_recent_selection: A/B are fixed retrospective diagnostic contrasts; never select features from in-sample validation predictions of this model trained through December
scope: FPT OHLCV only; no other stock, index, news or new target/horizon
role: adaptive retrospective feature experiment on already inspected 2022-2026; no fresh independent holdout or live-forward improvement claim
